title: Everyday Phrases — Passing Through Customs
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🛂 實用過海關必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱B1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Passing Through Customs
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用過海關情境對話：機上填入境卡、移民官查問按指紋、海關開包檢查限額與申報、通關後轉機與離開機場（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多旅行場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Passing Through Customs phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue): filling the arrival card on the plane, passport and fingerprint checks, customs bag inspection with duty limits, and clearing out to your connection. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life travel scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, go ahead and sit down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is a long flight, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope to sleep the whole way.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp tu slip ðə hoʊl weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我希望能一路睡到抵達。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我去探親看姊姊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, do we need an arrival card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi duː wi niːd ən əˈraɪvl kɑːrd?/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，我們需要填入境卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please fill it out before landing.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliːz fɪl ɪt aʊt bɪˈfɔːr ˈlændɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I write for the name?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ʃʊd aɪ raɪt fər ðə neɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Copy it exactly from your passport.
dialogue.zh: 照著護照上的名字，原原本本抄上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And where do I find the flight number?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wɛr du aɪ faɪnd ðə flaɪt ˈnʌmbər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's printed on your boarding pass.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wherever you're staying, hotel or home.
dialogue.zh: 你住哪就填哪，飯店或住家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm staying at my sister's place.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You said family, so check relatives.
dialogue.zh: 你說探親，那就勾親友拜訪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the date of entry?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I list my whole stay?
dialogue.zh: 要填完整的停留時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they match it against your visa.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðeɪ mætʃ ɪt əˈɡɛnst jɔːr ˈviːzə./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucky you, traveling with the kids.
dialogue.zh: 你好厲害，帶著小孩一起旅行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 今天他們很乖，謝天謝地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The seatbelt light just came on.
dialogue.zh: 繫安全帶的燈剛亮起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 機長已經事先提醒過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I tip my seat back?
dialogue.zh: 我可以把椅背往後傾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like chicken or pasta?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's your meal and some water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, I spilled a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, I'll clean it up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only when they're over the limit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the receipt inside your bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do they ask for receipts?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 用來核對你的購買金額。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six hundred dollars worth of goods.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many cigarettes can I bring?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, how many did you buy?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four packs. I forgot the limit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is alcohol handled the same way?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wine is only one bottle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only have a few hundred.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fruit is banned, dried or fresh.
dialogue.zh: 水果一律禁止，不管是乾的還是新鮮的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？我媽幫我裝了一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better toss them at the airport.
dialogue.zh: 最好在機場就把它們丟掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I take pills for my heart.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a doctor's note?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只有強力處方藥才需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I fill the card right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks so much for helping me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How early can we get off?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 飛機停穩後大約二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's queue up right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need my arrival card back?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid maɪ əˈraɪvl kɑːrd bæk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們要把文件先備好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 護照拿在手，手機收起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are shaking a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 放輕鬆，他們只問基本問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I can't answer well?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're up at the counter now.
dialogue.zh: 現在輪到我們在櫃台前了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have your arrival card ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv jʊər əˈraɪvl kɑːrd ˈrɛdi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, right here with my passport.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the purpose of your visit?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do you plan to stay?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ du ju plæn tu steɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你的回程航班是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday evening, flight six oh two.
dialogue.zh: 星期五傍晚，六零二航班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that the address on your card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ði əˈdrɛs ɑːn jɔːr kɑːrd?/
dialogue.zh: 卡上寫的就是那個地址嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you do for work?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I teach history at a college.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you visited this country before?
dialogue.zh: 你以前到過這個國家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's my very first time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any entry problems in the past?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your visa is valid for one year.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔːr ˈviːzə ɪz ˈvælɪd fər wʌn jɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I got it last month.
dialogue.zh: 還好，簽證我上個月才辦好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has anyone packed your bags for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæz ˈɛniwʌn pækt jɔːr bæɡz fər ju?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只有姊姊幫我折了幾件衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you carrying bags for other people?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑːr ju ˈkæriɪŋ bæɡz fər ˈʌðər ˈpipəl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, every bag here is mine.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，這裡每件行李都是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please place two fingers on the scanner.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz pleɪs tu ˈfɪŋɡərz ɑːn ðə ˈskænər./
dialogue.zh: 請把兩根手指放在掃描器上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, now the left hand, same fingers.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs naʊ ðə lɛft hænd seɪm ˈfɪŋɡərz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這比我想像中簡單多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We also need a quick photo.
dialogue.zh: 我們還需要快速拍張照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I take off my glasses?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, remove them for the photo.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, now you can see me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 之前我眨了兩次眼，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your stay is approved for ninety days.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔːr steɪ ɪz əˈpruːvd fər ˈnaɪnti deɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six days is plenty for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Admitted until the seventh of September.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I fly home well before then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, glad to be here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The line moved up really fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is that family still waiting?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 他們的文件要多核對一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這裡常需要第二關檢查嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a few people get picked.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this lane for visitors too?
dialogue.zh: 這條通道也是給訪客的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that desk is for residents.
dialogue.zh: 不是，那個櫃台是給居民的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 自動關卡也要按指紋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take them off and try again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Baggage claim is on level one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們的航班是哪條轉盤？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen says our bags are delayed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skriːn sɛz ˈaʊər bæɡz ər dɪˈleɪd./
dialogue.zh: 螢幕說我們的行李延誤了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I keep this baggage stub?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, until you exit the airport.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的行李一直沒轉出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 工作人員找到了我的箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 真幸運，很多行李會不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It has a small dent, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過箱子被撞凹了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Report it before you leave today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next to customs, on the right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They filed a claim form for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ faɪld ə kleɪm fɔːrm fər miː./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the copy for the airline.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Choose green if nothing to declare.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag holds four gift boxes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So can I use the green lane?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kæn aɪ juz ðə ɡriːn leɪn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the red lane it is.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This lane is for declaring items.
dialogue.zh: 這條通道是給要申報的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 誠實申報總比被罰好，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set your bags on this table.
dialogue.zh: 請把行李放上這張桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and unzip the big suitcase.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me see the bottles, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both add up to one liter.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I don't owe any tax?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The limit is only two packs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You'll pay duty on two extra.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card or cash for the fee?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 懂了，用釘書機釘在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What are these small brown bottles?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 自家做的食品不能入境。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？它是真空包裝耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still no, please use that bin.
dialogue.zh: 還是不行，請丟進垃圾桶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 猜對了，我媽堅持要包裝好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this a new watch? Who's it for?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ə nuː wɑtʃ huz ɪt fər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add that to your gift total.
dialogue.zh: 把這個加進禮物的總價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gifts plus the watch, two eighty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the limit, so no duty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 請把筆記型電腦拿出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but only as a hobby.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 九十天份的用藥是允許的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I only brought a month's worth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這個包好的禮物裡是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A silk scarf for my niece.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, go ahead and unwrap.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 掃描器標記了這個小包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just power banks, all brand new.
dialogue.zh: 只是行動電源，全都是全新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 備用電池要放手提行李。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All in my carry-on right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔːl ɪn maɪ ˈkæri ɑːn raɪt hɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four's the max, and you're fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 備用的都隨身帶上飛機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這個包裡有尖銳物品嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 一個指甲刀，沒有別的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 鬆口氣了，第一次出關真嚇人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我現在幫你的申報單封口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like help with bags?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 穿過那邊的玻璃門就是。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我的家人就在那裡等我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You may get checked again randomly.
dialogue.zh: 你可能還會被隨機檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 誠實申報讓你過得更快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's eat, then tell it all.
dialogue.zh: 我們先吃，再講給大家聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們只是笑笑自己罷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I keep the customs slip?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ kiːp ðə ˈkʌstəmz slɪp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I show this slip at the exit?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ʃoʊ ðɪs slɪp æt ðə ˈɛɡzɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 離開時要出示這張單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if staff ask you to.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I lose the arrival card?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ luːz ði əˈraɪvl kɑːrd?/
dialogue.zh: 如果把入境卡弄丟了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Report it at the airline desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm keeping it safe, trust me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這是每次旅行的好習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go on, we'll mind the bags.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 睡了，現在跟爸爸在車上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們趕快把後車廂裝好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wine survived the whole trip.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrapped in sweaters, not a crack.
dialogue.zh: 用毛衣包著，一點裂痕都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time, I'll skip the snacks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No more dried fruit next trip.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small fee beats a fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the way, what about connections?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I recheck my bag for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ riːˈtʃɛk maɪ bæɡ fər ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 轉機要重新託運行李嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's checked all the way.
dialogue.zh: 不用，行李直接送到終點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tag reads my final stop.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough for food and the gate.
dialogue.zh: 夠吃個飯再前往登機口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 穿過安檢後的大廳末端。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I clear customs again there?
dialogue.zh: 那邊還需要再過一次海關嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will they print my next pass?
dialogue.zh: 他們會印我下一段登機證嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my first flight runs late?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf maɪ fɜːrst flaɪt rʌnz leɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 如果前一班延誤怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag missed a flight once.
dialogue.zh: 我有一次行李沒跟上飛機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, to my hotel the next day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu maɪ hoʊˈtɛl ðə nɛkst deɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heading home, it's the same drill.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I bought cheese and tea for my family.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɔt tʃiːz ænd tiː fər maɪ ˈfæməli./
dialogue.zh: 我買了起司和茶送家人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，但鮮活植物不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll leave the seeds at home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Declare it on the customs form.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I carry my old passport?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety days is my visa limit.
dialogue.zh: 我的簽證上限是九十天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set a reminder to leave early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 逾期停留的話，下次入境會很麻煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way to the taxi stand?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni eɪ tiː ˈɛm nɪr ðə dɔːrz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone has no signal yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 機場的無線網路是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Customs was easier than I feared.
dialogue.zh: 過海關比我想像的輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 準備工作就成功一半了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next flight, I'll fill out cards onboard.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst flaɪt aɪl fɪl aʊt kɑːrdz ˌɑːnˈboːrd./
dialogue.zh: 下次機上我就先把卡填好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we meet at the food court?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi miːt æt ðə fud kɔːrt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們能在美食街碰面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We watched that gate for an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɑːtʃt ðæt ɡeɪt fər ən ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 我們在那個出口等了一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只有海關人員打開看過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home at last, bags by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊm æt læst bæɡz baɪ ðə dɔːr./
dialogue.zh: 終於到家，行李擱在門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One folder for all trip papers.
dialogue.zh: 所有旅行文件放一個資料夾。
